## NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B API

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B is a large language model by NVIDIA, available on the Venice API as `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-120b-a12b`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal vision-language model for specialized agents. Its 120B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts design (12B active) understands text, images, documents, GUIs, and video, combining reasoning, instruction following, and tool use for long-running agentic workflows.

### NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-120b-a12b` | Standard | Private | $0.20 / $0.50 per 1M |

| Spec | Value |

| Context window | 256K tokens |

### How to use the NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-120b-a12b"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-120b-a12b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
